target_cues: Official cached shot-chart player, period, and clock identify the intended event in clips with multiple attempts. These are not detector-selected tracking labels. They never determine the reference release frame.
indexing: Zero-based decoded original MP4 frames, 25 FPS; all 50 tracking-array lengths equal decoded frame counts.
prior_annotations: No existing blind manual annotations for this cohort were found locally or in the branch. Five-clip artifacts belong to other cohorts.
acquisition_retry: First acquisition attempt stopped after a Python certificate-store failure. Same 50 IDs retried with verified certifi trust roots; no shots replaced.
